name: Laminar
desc: Open-source observability with browser recordings synced to agent traces.
desc_zh: 开源可观测平台，把浏览器录像与 Agent 轨迹对齐。
solves: Shows you what the agent actually saw on screen when a run went wrong, not just the final log line.
solves_zh: Agent 出错时能看到它当时在屏幕上看到了什么，而不只是最后一行日志。
best_for: Reaching for it when you are debugging browser or computer-use agents specifically.
best_for_zh: 专门调试浏览器类或 computer-use 类 Agent 时。
notes: 外部发现渠道补录：2026 Langfuse-alternative comparison articles; YC S24 listing。来源：https://laminar.sh/article/langfuse-alternatives-2026
